items.title: What's on This Page
items.why:
Your other 12 equipment picks are saved. 2.29.0 waits for this page.

I built three working layouts in a test copy and tapped through them. Whichever you pick replaces the button blobs on the setup questions: experience, goal, equipment, diet, allergies, sports and the coach chat. The coach's follow-up questions and Settings → About You use the same code, so they change too.

Any mix works: one layout for equipment, another for the rest.

items.title: Most Questions
items.why:
How long the Your Training screen is (the visible part is 696 tall):

Now: 1,486
Dropdowns: 842
Lists: 1,290
Tiles: 2,841

Lists and tiles include their equipment choices, which take most of that room.

options.label: Dropdowns
options.desc: One line per question. Tap to open the choices; picking one closes it. Where you can pick several it stays open until Done.

items.title: Equipment, With Pictures
items.why: Each piece gets a picture, what it is in plain words, and how many exercises it unlocks (counted from the app's own list, with your new exercises included). Home equipment comes first, gym equipment second.

options.label: Dropdown
options.desc: Closed, after picking, and open (shown small).

options.label: Two folding lists
options.desc: For Home and Mostly at a Gym open separately.

items.title: Dropdown, Full Size
items.why: The open equipment dropdown at real size, for reading the text. Setup looks the same in light and dark mode.

items.title: The Equipment Pictures
items.why: My own drawings, so there's no license to worry about, and they add almost nothing to the download. They're simple icons, not photos.

options.label: Have ChatGPT draw them
options.desc: I add them to the picture brief you asked for. Color drawings until then.

items.title: Sports Screen
items.why: The search box stays on top. Same dropdown, for anyone who picks "Get better at my sport".

items.title: Coach Chat Answers
items.why: Each question here has only 2 to 5 answers, so a dropdown would add a tap.

items.title: Days a Week, Meals a Day
items.why: These already have a big number with − and +, plus a row of number buttons below that does the same job.

items.title: Button Groups Outside Setup
items.why: The same style of buttons also appears in: activity effort (1 to 10), stomach symptoms, sore areas, skill events and stages, plate sizes, and some filters. They're used daily, so an extra tap costs more there.

options.label: Setup now, show me those next
options.desc: Their own review page with pictures.

items.title: Mistakes on My Last Page
items.why:
I said I had re-checked every source. I hadn't: three pages were left out. I've now read them, and found these mistakes of mine:

Hamstring curl: the tip "keep your knees side by side" isn't in the source. It's now "Move slowly and with control", which is.

Hip abduction: the NHS has you face the wall. Step reworded.

Alice and the vest: I said Henry Ford Health limits vest jumps to a warm-up. It calls the vest a great warm-up tool, but doesn't say only that. This wasn't in the app's text.

Marching: I said the NHS version holds a support. It doesn't mention one. You left marching out.

Drawings: without the vest push-up, 3 exercises borrow a drawing and 11 show the muscle map and steps.

Vest weight: ACE's vest page gives study loads, not a safety limit, so the app won't cite it as one.

items.title: Publish 2.29.0?
items.why: Equipment, exercises, safety notes and the new layouts together, after every check passes on both looks. Nothing on anyone's phone is erased.
